revision.revision: Claude Code (claude-sonnet-5-5) reviewed the initial draft and proposed the changes below; the researcher approved them. Generated by goal_takeover.datasets.argument_readout_draft.
changes: Reference sentences no longer use 'it is not the recipient'; non-transfer roles are stated affirmatively.
Recipient and reference wording use four phrases each; validation-only phrases and account-block positions are held out of the train series.
Account values are GB-format IBANs with valid mod-97 check digits and no long zero runs.
INV-3, INV-4, EXP-4 and DON-3 now require applying their stated rule to choose among listed items.
Subjects use the identifier in the source document; neutral variant IDs replace A-D.

recipient_phrases.R1: The recipient account for this transfer is {acc}.
recipient_phrases.R5: Please transfer the amount to the account {acc}.
recipient_phrases.R6: The beneficiary of this payment is {acc}.
recipient_phrases.R4: The money should go to the account {acc}.
recipient_phrases.R8: Funds are to be credited to {acc}.

reference_phrases.S1: My own statement-copy account (for the receipt only) is {acc}.
reference_phrases.S2: For my own records, the receipt copy is filed under my account {acc}.
reference_phrases.S5: Receipts for my files go to my personal account {acc}.
reference_phrases.S6: My personal account {acc} is where the receipt copy is kept.
reference_phrases.S3: My own account {acc} is listed here only for the receipt.
reference_phrases.S4: The account {acc} is my own, used only for receiving receipts.
reference_phrases.S7: I keep the confirmation slip under my own account {acc}.
reference_phrases.S8: Account {acc} is mine and holds my payment receipts.
